tasks.short: Prepare and review operational and project progress reports.

steps.what: Prepare operational reports from ticket totals
Draft project progress commentary from those totals

loop.purpose: Draft commentary that cites ticket totals
loop.input: operational total rows and project progress rows
loop.check: every number matches a row and cites its id
loop.stop: one draft, or stop when a number has no row
loop.why_not_simpler: the period story changes, so a fixed sentence does not fit

steps.what: Review operational reports and project progress

outputs: filed copy of signed operational report v1

tasks.design: A dashboard on {BI} prepares operational totals. A bounded draft in {DOCS} may comment only with figures that cite those rows. The manager reviews project progress, signs the report, and a job publishes that version. The draft is not the report.
tasks.previous_blocker: Reports were reassembled each period, and a number could not be traced to a ticket.
tasks.enabler_now: Ticket and project totals already exist.
tasks.still_hard: What the progress means is still the manager's judgement.
tasks.human_edge: The manager decides whether the report is fit to send.

ambition.what: Refresh the operational tables when the period totals close, and publish only a newly signed report.

tasks.altitude: The manager spends the cycle on the review and the signature.

evidence.claim: The management digest says a records path can draft a report that cites record ids, and a person signs.
The management digest says security and IT work uses ticket and incident-log configuration, and judgement stays manual.

assumptions: A number with no row is removed before signature.
Configure the existing totals before a new store.
research_questions: How often totals are restated after signature.

already_counted.description: Reviewing the report stays inside the remaining time of that step.

incremental.description: Remap ticket or ledger fields when the record layout changes, and clear exceptions the job cannot file.

time_saved_range_pct.basis: Only assembly and filing move to a job. The meeting, the decision, and the signature stay with the manager, after a small upkeep allowance.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

tasks.short: Evaluate processing proposals for feasibility and requirements.

steps.what: Evaluate data processing proposals for feasibility
Check proposal fields against the required list
Assess project requirements the proposal must meet

outputs: filed copy of signed feasibility note v1

tasks.design: Coded checks flag missing fields on the proposal in {DOCS}. The manager evaluates feasibility, assesses the project requirements, signs the note, and a job files that version. A complete form is not a feasibility decision.
tasks.previous_blocker: Proposals were read without a fixed list of what they must contain.
tasks.enabler_now: Required fields can be checked without a new platform.
tasks.still_hard: Feasibility still depends on capacity and risk the form does not hold.
tasks.human_edge: The manager decides whether the proposal can proceed.

ambition.what: Return a proposal the same day a required field is empty.

tasks.altitude: The manager spends the evaluation on feasibility, not on blank fields.

reach.task: Close the gaps named in the signed note

evidence.claim: The management digest says security and IT work uses ticket and incident-log configuration, and judgement stays manual.
The management digest says a records path can draft a report that cites record ids, and a person signs.

assumptions: The check does not judge feasibility.
Configure the document store before a new tool.
unknowns: Who else must sign a go-ahead.
research_questions: How often proposals arrive in a form the check cannot read.

already_counted.description: Evaluating feasibility stays inside the remaining time of that step.

incremental.description: Remap ticket or ledger fields when the record layout changes, and clear exceptions the job cannot file.

time_saved_range_pct.basis: Only assembly and filing move to a job. The meeting, the decision, and the signature stay with the manager, after a small upkeep allowance.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

tasks.short: Control the operational budget and expenditures.

steps.what: Control the operational budget against expenditures
Compare posted expenditures with budget lines

outputs: filed copy of signed budget note v1

tasks.design: A job compares expenditures already posted in {ERP} with the budget lines. The manager controls the budget, signs the note in {DOCS}, and a job files that version. Posting the ledger is existing system work and is not counted as the manager's time.
tasks.previous_blocker: The manager rebuilt the variance from exports before each review.
tasks.enabler_now: Posted rows and budget lines can be compared by a fixed rule.
tasks.still_hard: Whether a variance is acceptable is still a decision.
tasks.human_edge: The manager decides what to stop, move, or allow.

ambition.what: Show the variance when the period closes, before the control note is signed.

tasks.altitude: The manager spends the review on the decision, not on rebuilding the variance.

reach.task: Post only what the ledger already holds
reach.learn: Which budget version the note used

evidence.claim: The management digest says a records path can draft a report that cites record ids, and a person signs.
The management digest says security and IT work uses ticket and incident-log configuration, and judgement stays manual.

assumptions: The comparison reads posted rows and does not post them.
Configure the ledger before a new store.
unknowns: Who may move budget between lines.
Which expenditures are in this department.
research_questions: How late postings arrive after the review date.

already_counted.description: Controlling the budget stays inside the remaining time of that step.

incremental.description: Remap ticket or ledger fields when the record layout changes, and clear exceptions the job cannot file.

time_saved_range_pct.basis: Only assembly and filing move to a job. The meeting, the decision, and the signature stay with the manager, after a small upkeep allowance.

steps.what: Select the necessary equipment to purchase
Price the equipment from the price table

outputs: filed copy of signed equipment purchase v1

tasks.design: The manager selects the necessary equipment. A job prices it from the price table in {PROCUREMENT}. The manager signs that list, and only then does a job send it. An unsigned list is not sent.
tasks.previous_blocker: Requests left the mailbox before anyone checked them against the price table.
tasks.enabler_now: A selected list can be priced before it is sent.
tasks.still_hard: What to buy still depends on the need.
tasks.human_edge: The manager decides the purchase and the version that is sent.

ambition.what: Reprice the list when the price table changes, and send only the newly signed version.

tasks.altitude: The manager spends the purchase on the selection and the signature.

evidence.claim: The management digest says security and IT work uses ticket and incident-log configuration, and judgement stays manual.
The management digest says a records path can draft a report that cites record ids, and a person signs.

assumptions: The send stops if the price table changed after signature.
Configure the procurement record before a new store.
unknowns: Who may send a purchase above a set amount.
Whether the manager or a buyer owns the vendor.
research_questions: How often the price table is updated.

already_counted.description: Selecting the equipment stays inside the remaining time of that step.

incremental.description: Remap ticket or ledger fields when the record layout changes, and clear exceptions the job cannot file.

time_saved_range_pct.basis: Only assembly and filing move to a job. The meeting, the decision, and the signature stay with the manager, after a small upkeep allowance.

role.altitude: The information systems manager spends the week on priorities, people, and the signed decision. Ticket totals and filing a signed note move to a job. A backup that already runs is not saved labour.
reach: Service desk leads receive a signed priority list instead of a verbal shuffle.
Analysts see the assignment the manager signed, not a score.
skills_to_grow: Reject a report figure that has no ticket or ledger row.
Keep hiring, assignment, and access changes as their own decision.
role.ambitious_version: A signed priority list can open the week's work board, and the manager still releases it.
